title: Larry King Live with Buzz Aldrin, and 'somebody's gotten to him'
summary: James Fox tells of Larry King Live with Buzz Aldrin, and 'somebody's gotten to him', about about 2007 at Larry King Live studio, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Aldrin's 2007 Larry King Live appearance, with James Fox present, where he played down the sighting.

as_told.title: Aldrin on Larry King Live calls it an S-IVB panel
